dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concave spline, transitioning from a vertical posterior base to a nearly horizontal curvature approaching the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius; the highest point lacks acute or obtuse angularity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: A very shallow, low-gradient linear slope ascending from the anterior ridge at approximately 20-25 degrees relative to the horizontal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Elongated base-to-height ratio, approximately 1.8:1, indicating a long, low-profile dorsal structure.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct white scarring and irregular depigmentation patches visible at the posterior lower boundary of the fin and body segment; numerous small white punctate marks are distributed across the lateral fin surface.
